videos.title: Righteousness by Faith Before the Final Deception | Elder Rueben Swain
videos.description: Elder Rueben Swain explores righteousness by faith and preparation for the final deception. Drawing from Hebrews, Revelation, and Romans, this sermon asks what it means for Christ to dwell in us as we study the closing events of Bible prophecy.

videos.title: Were Seventh-Day Adventists Responsible for the Great Disappointment in 1844?
videos.description: This clip from our Sanctuary series examines a common misconception about William Miller and the Great Disappointment of 1844. We discuss the Christian denominations involved in the Millerite movement and the later organization of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

videos.title: The Time is at Hand: Preparing Souls for Jesus' Return - Sermon by Michael Porter
videos.description: Michael Porter explores repentance, conversion, and the call to become fishers of men. Drawing from Matthew 4:17, this sermon considers how personal transformation, compassion, and sharing present truth prepare souls for Jesus' return.

videos.title: The Sabbath vs. Sunday debate: The Mark of the Lamb (Part 2) - Sermon by Rueben Swain
videos.description: In Part 2 of The Mark of the Lamb, Rueben Swain continues his study of the Sabbath as a sign of God's authority. The sermon examines worship, allegiance, and the call to keep God's commandments through Exodus, Hebrews, and Revelation.

videos.title: The Mark of the Lamb: Sabbath vs. Sunday, A Biblical Perspective (Part 1) - Sermon by Rueben Swain
videos.description: Rueben Swain examines the Sabbath, God's seal, and the mark of the beast in this biblical study of worship and allegiance. Part 1 of The Mark of the Lamb draws from Exodus and Revelation to explore the call to remain faithful to God's commandments.

videos.title: Is Jesus Christ our high Priest? - Sermon by Dr. Joseph Thomas
videos.description: Dr. Joseph Thomas explores Christ's role as our High Priest and the sanctuary as a witness to God's work of redemption. This sermon considers biblical testimony, the altar of witness, and how believers can reflect Christ through their character.

videos.title: The Plan of Redemption (The Play) Part 2 - Sermon by Rueben Swain
videos.description: Rueben Swain continues The Plan of Redemption with a study of current events and Bible prophecy. This sermon examines Project 2025, economic uncertainty, civil unrest, and the Sunday law in the context of preparation for the last days.

videos.title: The Plan of Redemption (The Play) - Sermon by Rueben Swain
videos.description: Rueben Swain explores how the sanctuary reveals God's plan of redemption. Drawing from the creation account, Psalm 77, and 2 Peter 3, this sermon considers God's timing and the importance of unity in understanding His plan.

videos.title: Revisiting the Charlie Kirk Shooting: How This Divided the SDA Church
videos.description: The Charlie Kirk shooting didn't just shake the political world—it exposed a deep division inside the SDA Church. In this episode we turn to the Bible and the Spirit of Prophecy, including Ellen White's 1899 prophecy on civil war and the centralizing of wealth, to examine the shaking of God's remnant people, the close of probation, and what every believer should be doing right now.

videos.title: The Three Angels’ Message & The Sanctuary Truth: (Day of Atonement Study)
videos.description: In this Bible study we connect the Day of Atonement to the Investigative Judgment, the heavenly sanctuary, and the Three Angels' Messages of Revelation 14. We explore why Revelation points back to God's law in the Most Holy Place, why 'Babylon is fallen' is a call to come out of false worship, and how the final conflict centers on worship, the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

videos.title: The Day of Atonement & the Cleansing of the Sanctuary (Bible Study)
videos.description: In this Bible study, we break down the Day of Atonement and the cleansing of the sanctuary—why God established it, what it reveals about sin and atonement, and how it connects to the judgment and the opening of the books. We walk through the sanctuary pattern, why atonement requires blood and a High Priest, and how Scripture shows judgment for the living and the dead.

videos.title: Daniel 8: Pagan Rome to Papal Rome & The Dark Ages
videos.description: In this powerful continuation, we answer the question everyone asks: Is Antiochus Epiphanes the Antichrist? The Bible and history say, NO. Join our 5-person Bible study as we trace Rome through BOTH its phases (pagan and papal) and see how Scripture predicted it thousands of years in advance.

videos.title: The Little Horn Power Exposed | Bible Prophecy Explained
videos.description: Who is the Little Horn in Daniel 8 and why do so many get it wrong? In this deep-dive Bible study, we examine Daniel's vision and prove why Antiochus Epiphanes is not the fulfillment.
